digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (under Strychnos mitis)

teaser.en: Crack its hard round shell and you find sweet orange pulp, one of the bushland's wild treats.
teaser.sw: Vunja ganda lake gumu la mviringo nawe utakuta nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa, mojawapo ya vitafunio vya porini vya vichakani.

summary.en: *Mkpwakpwa*, the black monkey orange, is a thornless shrub or small tree of coastal bushland with hard round fruits full of sweet orange pulp. Pakia lists it among the edible wild fruits of the Digo.
summary.sw: *Mkpwakpwa*, au mkwakwa, ni kichaka au mti mdogo usio na miiba wa vichaka vya pwani, wenye matunda magumu ya mviringo yaliyojaa nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa. Pakia anauorodhesha miongoni mwa matunda ya porini yanayoliwa na Wadigo.

about.en: *Mkpwakpwa* is a shrub or small tree with no thorns, which separates it from its spiny cousin *muhonga*. The leaves are glossy. The fruits are hard and round, like small cannonballs, and turn from green toward yellow-orange as they ripen. Inside, seeds are packed in a sweet, orange pulp.
about.sw: *Mkpwakpwa* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usio na miiba, jambo linaloutofautisha na binamu yake mwenye miiba, *muhonga*. Majani yake yanang'aa. Matunda yake ni magumu na ya mviringo, kama makombora madogo ya mzinga, na hubadilika kutoka kijani kuelekea manjano-chungwa yanapoiva. Ndani yake, mbegu zimesheheni katika nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and woodland. Fruiting trees are easiest to find by looking for the round fruits hanging among the leaves.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu ya wazi. Miti yenye matunda ni rahisi kuipata kwa kutafuta matunda ya mviringo yanayoning'inia katikati ya majani.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten: the shell is broken open and the sweet orange pulp sucked from around the seeds. Pakia lists *mkpwakpwa* among the edible fruits of the Digo.
uses.sw: Tunda lake huliwa: ganda huvunjwa na nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa hufyonzwa kutoka kwenye mbegu. Pakia anaorodhesha *mkpwakpwa* miongoni mwa matunda yanayoliwa na Wadigo.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mkpwakpwa*, along with *muhonga*, *musikiro* and *mkwakwa*. *Muhonga* is also the name recorded for the spiny monkey orange, *Strychnos spinosa*, so the two may share it. In Swahili it is *mkwakwa*. Giriama names are *mujaje* and *mkwakwa*, and in Chonyi it is *mkwakwa*. The ICRAF handbook lists these names under *Strychnos mitis*.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa jina la Kidigo *mkpwakpwa*, pamoja na *muhonga*, *musikiro* na *mkwakwa*. *Muhonga* pia ni jina lililorekodiwa kwa mkwakwa wenye miiba, *Strychnos spinosa*, hivyo huenda miti hii miwili inashiriki jina hilo. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkwakwa*. Majina ya Kigiriama ni *mujaje* na *mkwakwa*, na kwa Kichonyi ni *mkwakwa*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaorodhesha majina haya chini ya *Strychnos mitis*.
